participant_a_prompt_text: Recall a challenging situation you faced together, and describe how you think you could have been more helpful to your partner during that time. Discuss what you learned from the experience and how you can apply it to future challenges.
participant_b_prompt_text: Your partner will tell you about a time they think you could have been more helpful to them. Listen to their perspective and discuss how you can work together to improve your communication and support each other better in the future.
